assumptions.statement: No trusted official overall-design polygon is published; SITE-001 is provisional geometry carried forward without relocation.
assumptions.impact: All areas and ratios using the site denominator are internal machine checks, not statutory or precise planning conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All three key-area polygons are provisional. PROV-KEY-003 is not anchored to Dazhongsi Station.
assumptions.impact: Key-area test fits and station-related concepts must be relocated and recomputed when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines, parcel controls, and total floor area are missing.
assumptions.impact: Control values remain unknown and no case-study average substitutes for approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Verified existing buildings, ownership, structure, fire, heritage, and tenancy data are missing.
assumptions.impact: Buildings are conceptual test fits only; retain-renovate-demolish remains pending official survey.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, energy, communications, waste, and public-service capacity data are missing.
assumptions.impact: New infrastructure has strategy and gating only, not final siting or engineering capacity.

assumptions.statement: No implementing agency, public budget, procurement, investment, displacement, or government event commitment is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Projects and operations are evidence-gated proposals requiring authority, funding, and permissions.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use data minimisation, no facial recognition by default, documented human takeover, appeal, deletion, and stop conditions.
assumptions.impact: Any operator must complete a new privacy, safety, accessibility, and legal review before a live pilot.

assumptions.statement: Seven global cases inform mechanisms only.
assumptions.impact: External area, jobs, investment, programme output, success rate, or governance authority is not transferred.
